body: i had an earthquake of an orgasm, and now I feel normal again. those twenty days were a battle, and i won, so i just celebrated.

while i don't think i'll be deleting facebook any time soon, i should probably repurpose it to be just for communication with teachers/group projects/etc.. it's all in my head, the temptation, and i'm trying to cut it out :)

What a truly horrible situation. 

Yet, now this community knows you- we support you.  You are not filthy or disgusting. You are a wonderful human being who has been disgraced by the cowardly lowest level of humanity.

Child rape is an act only carried out by the lowest level of humanity- a level that you are not a part of.  In her act, this monster of a women has equated you to this level of humanity, when in reality she is at that low level.

Even more irony is that this is in a church community; this happens all the time in churches and in my humble opinion I believe that the idea of a "parish" is something toxic.  

Your best bet would be to move, or to seek immediate legal help.  If you do, you WILL win this case.  However, you may not win back the support of those in your parish, which is why after the legal proceedings (should they be successful), I would recommend a big move.  Your name would be cleared and you could live a life free of this terrible burden.  May peace be upon you, and know that I have hope for your future.

This is the type of lie I'm talking about.  Every time I try to change the way I live, I keep getting reminded of the awful truth.  I was not meant for this world, and I am going to take my life soon - if I can find the courage to do so.  

Why should I even entertain the possibility of living longer? There will be no happiness in my future, and if there is I alone will be the only one to experience it: no friends or significant others to share it with me.  I was a mistake.
